test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A person starts from point H and moves 4 km towards the west. He turns left and moves 6 km. He then turns right and moves 2 km and turns left and moves 1 km. He then takes a left turn and moves 6 km and stops at point D. How much and in which direction does he need to move to reach point H?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) A person starts from point H and moves 4 km towards the west.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3066279c469b8163a19143156a615be0cbdad858c7295eb91bbd7eb2524bd10.png] 

2) He turns left and moves 6 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10a175391fe57f8803af7cd59367160615ae3281ee88c22710045da263bddfa5.png] 

3) He then turns right and moves 2 km and turns left and moves 1 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd46e05cd816294b8a504cbdbe6e9d4c3cc8299a7904890f26f1a0fbc0672936.png] 

4) He then takes a left turn and moves 6 km and stops at point D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4258806ae9e73db1b423bfadfd9c68b16d2c3a79a246e1a4b569301424f37ff3.png] 

Here, we can see that he needs to move 7 km in North direction to reach point H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****7 km, North"**.
